lswin.badge: LSWIN Core Module • Bulgarian Labor Code
lswin.title: Interactive Labor Contract Builder & Electronic Record Entry
lswin.body: Centralize labor contracts (Art. 67, Art. 68), probation terms (Art. 70), automated notification files for NAP (Art. 62 para. 5), and NSSI / NOI electronic service integrations.
lswin.xmlGen: Direct XML generation for National Revenue Agency (NAP) Portal
lswin.imgAlt: Bulgarian HR specialists working with Omega-TIM LSWIN
lswin.overlayBody: Sent to Labor Inspectorate (GLIT) & NAP Art. 62

rzwin.title: High-Velocity Payroll, Automatic NAP Filing & BISERA Direct Payouts
rzwin.body: Specifically engineered to handle intricate Bulgarian labor legislation, multi-tier tax rates, maternity leaves, and automatic generation of Deklaraciya 1 & Deklaraciya 6.
rzwin.item1: Automatic NSSI / NOI electronic sick leave submission (E-Bolnichni).
rzwin.item2: Instant Deklaraciya 1 and Deklaraciya 6 XML generator for the NAP portal.
rzwin.item3: BISERA and BORICA banking transfer packages (SEPA MT103/ISO 20022).
rzwin.netPayout: Net Payout to Bank (Чиста сума за получаване)

ac2012.title: General Ledger, Automated VAT Ledgers & Balance Sheets
ac2012.body: Complete double-entry accounting engineered for Bulgarian standard chart of accounts (Сметкоплан) with automated month-end closing and VAT file generation.
ac2012.item1: Automatic generation of VAT registers (Дневник покупки & продажби).
ac2012.item2: Multi-currency balance sheets, trial balance, and automatic P&L reports.

honwin.title: HONWIN Civil Honorariums & Independent Contracts
honwin.body: Full control over civil contracts (Граждански договори), legally mandated expense deductions (NPR 25% or 40%), withholding taxes (DOD Art. 38), and NAP certification notes.

fuel.title: Fuel Manager: Corporate Fleet Consumption & Travel Orders
fuel.body: Track road waybills (Пътни листове), average vehicle fuel norms, company gas card integrations (OMV, Shell, Lukoil), and automatic posting into AC2012 expenses.

pldwin.title: PLDWIN: Electronic Banking & Mass Payment Hub
pldwin.body: Instant generation of payment orders to the budget and batch salary transfers for all major Bulgarian banking institutions via MT103 and ISO 20022 XML formats.
